unit: brand-object-person-scene appearance within an immutable asset bundle

state_semantics.present: Affirmative evidence meets the validated threshold.
state_semantics.absent: The relevant modality was observed with adequate coverage and the feature was not found.
state_semantics.unknown: Evidence is missing, unreadable, occluded, unsupported, contradictory, or below threshold.
state_semantics.not_applicable: The construct does not apply to this unit.

hard_rules: Do not infer paid sponsorship from brand presence alone.
Do not infer organic status from missing disclosure or missing relationship records.
Do not encode unknown as false, zero, an empty string, or an empty array.
Keep literal observations separate from entity links, relational judgments, and construct ratings.
Every positive model judgment must reference frame, track, OCR, transcript, or metadata evidence.
Do not build a composite implicit-ad score during the pilot.

asset_fields.asset_id: Stable research identifier for the post, clip, image, story, article, or broadcast segment.
asset_fields.source_platform: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, broadcast, editorial archive, manual import, or other.
asset_fields.source_native_id: Native source identifier where retention is permitted.
asset_fields.source_account_id_restricted: Creator/channel/account identifier stored according to the access class.
asset_fields.observed_at: Timestamp when metadata and public metrics were retrieved.
asset_fields.media_type: image, video, audio_visual, screenshot, article, or other.
asset_fields.duration_ms: Exact duration for temporal media; not_applicable for stills.
asset_fields.bundle_sha256: Hash binding originals, permitted derivatives, metadata, and manifests.
asset_fields.rights_access_class: metadata_only, embedded_review, research_environment, licensed_media, creator_permission, restricted, or unknown.
asset_fields.public_view_count: Cumulative source metric at observed_at; opportunity-to-see proxy only.
asset_fields.public_engagement_json: Likes, comments, shares, favorites, reposts, or analogous fields with source definitions.
asset_fields.native_paid_placement_signal: Creator/platform declaration or paid-partnership signal, including exact source field and state.

appearance_fields.appearance_id: Stable identifier for one brand-object-person-scene episode.
appearance_fields.end_ms: Last visible timestamp for the interval.
appearance_fields.brand_candidate: Canonical brand candidate plus alternative candidates.
appearance_fields.brand_link_state: confirmed, candidate, ambiguous, unknown, or not_applicable.
appearance_fields.product_category: watch, apparel, footwear, signage, app_interface, beverage, betting_service, prediction_market, or controlled other.
appearance_fields.product_model_candidates: Ranked product/model/SKU candidates with scores and catalog version.
appearance_fields.carrier_type: person, team, event, venue, broadcast_graphic, set, object, screen, editorial_voice, peer, or interface.
appearance_fields.presentation_role: worn, held, used, consumed, discussed, praised, demonstrated, background, decorative, adjacent, or unknown.
appearance_fields.logo_or_wordmark_present: Whether a logo, wordmark, or distinctive mark is visibly present.
appearance_fields.visible_screen_time_ms: Union of visible intervals for the entity.
appearance_fields.screen_time_share_valid: Share of analyzable video time with the appearance visible.
appearance_fields.screen_time_lower_bound_total: Visible time divided by total asset duration, treating unprocessed time as unknown.
appearance_fields.conditional_pixel_share_mean: Mean visible pixel share conditional on appearance.
appearance_fields.pixel_time_share: Duration-weighted visible pixel share over the full asset.
appearance_fields.saliency_mass_mean: Predicted fixation mass within the appearance mask.
appearance_fields.foreground_probability: Calibrated probability that the appearance is in the foreground.
appearance_fields.occlusion_type: none, object, self, frame_boundary, motion_blur, ui_overlay, unreadable, multiple, or unknown.
appearance_fields.readability: Legibility or identifiability of the mark/product.
appearance_fields.person_interaction: wearing, holding, using, consuming, pointing_at, looking_at, speaking_about, adjacent_to, none, or unknown.
appearance_fields.evidence_refs: Frame, mask, track, OCR, transcript, and metadata identifiers supporting the row.

text_audio_fields.visual_ocr_raw: Verbatim OCR observations with regions and timestamps.
text_audio_fields.platform_caption_raw: Creator/platform caption preserved separately from OCR and ASR.
text_audio_fields.brand_audio_mention: Brand/product mention candidate with phonetic and contextual evidence.
text_audio_fields.tag_link_code_present: Brand tag, affiliate link, promo code, shopping link, or call to action.

disclosure_fields.disclosure_exact_text: Verbatim text or audio; never normalized away.
disclosure_fields.disclosure_type: ad, sponsored, paid_partnership, gifted, affiliate, own_brand, promotional_content, not_sponsored, other, or unknown.
disclosure_fields.disclosure_modalities: visual, audible, platform_metadata, caption, hashtag, or multiple.
disclosure_fields.disclosure_precedes_first_brand_exposure: Whether the first disclosure began before the first brand appearance.
disclosure_fields.disclosure_ui_capture_complete: Whether the archived render includes relevant platform overlays and expanded captions.

relationship_fields.relationship_state: confirmed, creator_declared, probable, rumored, no_known_relationship, verified_none, unknown, or not_applicable.
relationship_fields.relationship_type: ambassador, one_off_paid, gifted, loaned, affiliate, team_sponsorship, event_sponsorship, venue_sponsorship, platform_partnership, employer, family, brand_owned, or other.
relationship_fields.announcement_date: Public announcement date, stored separately from effective dates.
relationship_fields.relationship_evidence_uri: Primary record, platform declaration, contract data, brand statement, or documented search trail.

construct_ratings.pitch_directness_0_100: Logo-only/background presence to explicit promotional offer and call to action.
construct_ratings.plot_or_task_integration_0_100: Degree to which the brand/product is causally integrated into the activity or narrative.
construct_ratings.naturalness_1_5: Forced/incongruent to organic/plausible, supported by narrative relevance, interaction plausibility, camera motivation, and branding excess.
construct_ratings.commercial_presentation_probability: Calibrated probability that the presentation is promotional, distinct from sponsorship status.
construct_ratings.ad_recognition_likelihood: Expected recognition of commercial intent; a content-side hypothesis requiring viewer validation.
construct_ratings.sport_event_cue_0_100: Strength of sport, event, team, athlete, or fandom cueing.
construct_ratings.betting_action_cue_0_100: Strength of wagering, odds, trading, prediction, payout, or actionability cues.
construct_ratings.reward_affect_0_100: Reward, winning, excitement, belonging, status, or positive-affect linkage.
construct_ratings.brand_person_association_0_100: Strength and clarity of the visual/narrative association between a person and brand.
construct_ratings.brand_context_association_0_100: Strength and clarity of the association between the brand and setting, occasion, event, or identity.

amplification_fields.amplification_id: Stable identifier for a downstream identification or amplification item.
amplification_fields.source_appearance_id: Original appearance being identified or amplified.
amplification_fields.amplifier_type: watchspotter, outfit_reviewer, fan_account, journalist, social_listening, affiliate, retailer, brand_repost, or other.
amplification_fields.identification_lag_seconds: Time between original appearance and amplification.
amplification_fields.brand_named: Whether the brand was explicitly named.
amplification_fields.model_named: Whether a specific model/SKU was named.
amplification_fields.shopping_or_affiliate_link: Whether the amplification includes a commercial action path.
amplification_fields.same_appearance_confidence: Confidence that the downstream item refers to the original appearance.

quality_fields.analyzable_time_share: Share of asset duration successfully processed.
quality_fields.analyzable_pixel_share: Share of image/frame area not lost to corruption or unsupported format.
quality_fields.method_agreement: Agreement among detector, OCR, retrieval, and VLM routes.
quality_fields.calibrated_probability: Probability calibrated for the exact claim type and subgroup.
quality_fields.human_review_status: pending, double_coded, adjudicated, accepted, rejected, or not_sampled.

evidence_required_for: all positive brand and product identifications

pilot_validation_gates.subjective_model_disagreement_rule: Model-human disagreement should not exceed human-human disagreement on the locked set.
pilot_validation_gates.unsupported_case_rule: Abstain rather than default to absence.
